title: Chapter 405 - 405 Twisting The Facts; Despicable!

Chapter 405 - 405 Twisting The Facts; Despicable!

Chapter 405 - 405 Twisting the Facts; Despicable!

405 Twisting the Facts; Despicable!

What happened backstage was only discussed in a small circle.

After all, this matter involved the popular celebrity Dai Jiexi and the mysterious young man…

Obviously, these two were not to be trifled with.

No one dared to gossip.

…

In the dressing room.

Ling Rou sat in front of the mirror and touched up her makeup.

This award ceremony was simply too important.

Creak!

The door to the dressing room was slowly pushed open.

Dai Jiexi, whose entire face was still red and swollen, walked in and sneered, “She’s still touching up her makeup.”

When Ling Rou saw her, she stood up in a panic.

Men were not allowed to enter the women’s dressing room.

Thus, Lin Fan was not by her side.

“Don’t tell me you think you can win some award?” Dai Jiexi continued. “What a joke!”

“Let me tell you, don’t even think about winning any awards on this stage in your lifetime!”

Her words were extremely firm.

Dai Jiexi knew very well how influential the Tang family was at the Golden Melody Awards.

As long as she met Ni Min later, she would tell her about it.

Ling Rou would no longer have a place in the entertainment industry, let alone the Golden Melody Awards!

“Ling Rou, are you ready?”

Li Fei’s clear voice sounded from outside. As she spoke, she slowly pushed open the dressing room’s door.

When she saw Dai Jiexi, Li Fei’s expression changed, and she asked, “Ling Rou, are you alright? Should we call Mr. Lin over?”

When Dai Jiexi heard the words ‘Mr. Lin,’ she was so scared that her face turned slightly pale. She did not dare to stay any longer and turned to leave quickly.

She only heaved a sigh of relief when she reached backstage.

At this moment, hurried footsteps sounded not far away.

Zheng Lei quickly ran over and shouted, “Jiexi, get ready. Sister Ni Min and Mr. Tang Hua are coming over soon!”

As Zheng Lei finished speaking, a noblewoman in luxurious clothes with an extraordinary temperament walked over slowly with a middle-aged man in a suit and leather shoes.

They were none other than Ni Min and Tang Hua!

They were here!

They really came!

Dai Jiexi ignored Zheng Lei and excitedly ran over, shouting, “Sister Ni Min!”

Ni Min turned around when she heard the voice.

Even though Ni Min and Dai Jiexi were cousins, they were very distant cousins.

In fact, before Ni Min became a celebrity, the two of them had never met.

After becoming a celebrity, she had only seen her a few times.

Dai Jiexi’s face was red and swollen.

Ni Min could not recognize her at all.

Dai Jiexi saw that Ni Min was a little confused, so she spoke again, “Sister Ni Min, it’s me. I’m Cousin Jiexi!”

She deliberately addressed her as her cousin to further improve their relationship.

As expected, Ni Min immediately remembered when she heard this and asked, “Jiexi, what happened to your face? Did someone bully you?”

Dai Jiexi was delighted.

Ni Min was indeed concerned about her.

‘Ling Rou, Lin Fan, I’ll teach you a lesson later!’

Dai Jiexi deliberately sobbed and said, “I… When I was backstage, I accidentally bumped into a newcomer.

“She felt that I did it on purpose, so she got her boyfriend to hit me…”

At this point, Dai Jiexi squeezed out a few tears.

Then, she quickly said, “I saw the chairman of Xin Mei Entertainment. He’s very friendly to her boyfriend… Anyway, the matter was over. I’ll just take it as though they were venting their anger.”

Dai Jiexi had some acting skills.

With just a few words, she easily disguised herself as a pitiful sheep.

At the same time, she turned Ling Rou and Lin Fan into savage and vicious wolves.

Ni Min hated unreasonable people who bullied others.

This was because when she was a singer, she had also experienced such a pitiful and helpless time.

“We can’t just let it go like this!”

“Don’t worry, Jiexi,” Tang Hua said. “We’ll help you.”

Dai Jiexi bit her lip lightly, as if she was having an intense internal struggle.

In reality?

She was already dancing with joy in her heart.

Ni Min and Tang Hua both spoke up!

‘Lin Fan, Ling Rou… Very soon, you’ll be finished!’

At this moment, Lin Fan, Ling Rou, Li Fei, and Wang Haohua walked out.

Dai Jiexi’s expression changed slightly, and she put on a terrified expression. She pointed at Lin Fan and Ling Rou, “They… It’s them!”

Tang Hua and Ni Min looked in the direction Dai Jiexi pointed.

In the next moment…

Both of their expressions changed.

Instantly, they no longer looked at Dai Jiexi pitifully. Instead, they looked at her with disgust, deep disgust!

One had to know…

Lin Fan had saved the life of the Tang family’s old master.

In addition, they also learned some things about Lin Fan from Zhou Guotao. He solved several math problems, invented the earthquake prediction device, the human islet recovery medicine, the super battery, and so on.

He was definitely a great scientist, a national treasure!

How could such a person be a tyrannical and reckless person?

What a joke!

Was she trying to fool them like monkeys?

When Tang Hua and Ni Min saw Lin Fan, Lin Fan also noticed them.

His expression remained calm.

On the other hand, the faces of Wang Haohua and Li Fei turned slightly pale.

They knew Ni Min and Tang Hua.

In the past, they had heard that Dai Jiexi seemed to have some relationship with Ni Min.

Now, seeing that Dai Jiexi was really with Ni Min, they could not help but panic.

One had to know…

Ni Min’s husband was the current head of the Tang family!

The Tang family was one of the two most powerful forces in Hong Kong!

It was over!

It was over!

Lin Fan did not care about the two panicking people and walked toward Ni Min and Tang Hua.

After all, they were acquaintances.

…

When Dai Jiexi saw Lin Fan walking toward her, she laughed coldly in her heart.

‘I was just thinking about how to teach you a lesson.

‘I didn’t expect you to come right over.’

“Are you talking about the young couple on the left?” Tang Hua asked with a gloomy face.

Dai Jiexi’s entire heart was filled with joy, so she did not notice the changes in Tang Hua and Ni Min.

She put on an extremely frightened expression and said with a trembling voice, “Yes, yes…It’s them. No, don’t…”

At this moment, Tang Hua suddenly raised his hand and slapped Dai Jiexi’s swollen face.

He really could not stand a woman lying to him like a stupid pig.

This slap stunned Dai Jiexi.

She covered her face in disbelief.

This…

This…

What was going on?

Why was she beaten up again?

Moreover, it seemed to be… Tang Hua?

Just as Dai Jiexi was in a daze, Lin Fan and Ling Rou walked over.

Tang Hua said with a slightly fawning tone, “Mr. Lin, Ms. Ling… Hello.”
